summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark, including the removal of Spark 3.4 support and adapting to Spark's new quarterly release schedule. Additionally, there are ongoing proposals for improving metadata representation, global snapshot consistency, and access policies.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration updates
Proposal to run CI on contributor forks to reduce usage
Discussion on global snapshot consistency for Iceberg tables
Upcoming Iceberg Terraform Provider release with new features
